Why Muhammad is a messenger

He asked no wage

Again and again the Quran has him say the same thing: he asks for no payment.

How do you weigh someone who brings a message? See what he asks for. The Quran has Muhammad say, more than once, that he asks no wage for it, and that it is a reminder for all the worlds. In its pages Noah and Hud say the same. His one hope, he says, is that a person may choose a way to their Lord. The message came free.

﴿أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَبِهُدَىٰهُمُ ٱقْتَدِهْ ۗ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا ۖ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Those are the ones whom Allāh has guided, so from their guidance take an example. Say, "I ask of you for it [i.e., this message] no payment. It is not but a reminder for the worlds."

Quran · Al-An'am 6:90

﴿قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."

Quran · Al-Furqan 25:57

﴿قُلْ مَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "Whatever payment I might have asked of you - it is yours. My payment is only from Allāh, and He is, over all things, Witness."

Quran · Saba 34:47

The same in the other books

Translation

Here I am. Witness against me before Yahweh and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken? Whom have I defrauded? Whom have I oppressed? Of whose hand have I taken a bribe to make me blind my eyes? I will restore it to you.” They said, “You have not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither have you taken anything from anyone’s hand.”

Original · Hebrew

הִנְנִ֣י עֲנ֣וּ בִי֩ נֶ֨גֶד יְהוָ֜ה וְנֶ֣גֶד מְשִׁיח֗וֹ אֶת־שׁוֹר֩ ׀ מִ֨י לָקַ֜חְתִּי וַחֲמ֧וֹר מִ֣י לָקַ֗חְתִּי וְאֶת־מִ֤י עָשַׁ֨קְתִּי֙ אֶת־מִ֣י רַצּ֔וֹתִי וּמִיַּד־מִי֙ לָקַ֣חְתִּי כֹ֔פֶר וְאַעְלִ֥ים עֵינַ֖י בּ֑וֹ וְאָשִׁ֖יב לָכֶֽם׃ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ לֹ֥א עֲשַׁקְתָּ֖נוּ וְלֹ֣א רַצּוֹתָ֑נוּ וְלֹֽא־לָקַ֥חְתָּ מִיַּד־אִ֖ישׁ מְאֽוּמָה׃

1 Samuel · 12:3-4

World English Bible

Translation

I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing. You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.

Original · Ancient Greek

ἀργυρίου ἢ χρυσίου ἢ ἱματισμοῦ οὐδενὸς ἐπεθύμησα· αὐτοὶ γινώσκετε ὅτι ταῖς χρείαις μου καὶ τοῖς οὖσι μετʼ ἐμοῦ ὑπηρέτησαν αἱ χεῖρες αὗται.

Acts · 20:33-34

World English Bible

You might ask

QuestionBut he became a ruler. Is that no reward?
AnswerIt is power, and this app will not deny it. The claim here is narrower: he charged nobody for the message. What power brought him is a separate question.Quran · Saba 34:47
QuestionWhat about the fifth of the spoils?
AnswerThe verse assigns it to God, the Messenger, his kin, orphans, the needy and travellers. Critics note his share, fairly. Beside it, weigh how he died: his armour in pawn.Quran · Al-Anfal 8:41
QuestionIsn't it easy just to say that?
AnswerEasy to say, and harder to keep up for twenty-three years as power grows. The Quran draws the line. His life is where you test it.Quran · Al-An'am 6:90

He gave the message away, and named one hope: that you find your way.
